tests.name: Pure validation, parameter callbacks and PR03 regression
Real turtlesim: 10 to 5 Hz, speed changes, zero and negative rejection, service and action
Invalid startup override rejected before timer creation

defect.reproducer: With on-set validation temporarily disabled, ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 caused patrol exit 1 with ZeroDivisionError in create_timer(1.0 / new_hz).
defect.root_cause: The post-set callback divided by the accepted zero frequency when calculating the new timer period.
defect.proof_after: With validation restored, ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 was rejected; get remained 5.0 and the command stream continued at 5.000 Hz. A valid 10 to 5 Hz update changed the stream to 4.999 Hz.
